$comment: Non-secret run configuration for the single fixed configuration (config_id=agent). Secrets live in .env.

model.$comment: Exact id from GET https://litellm.oit.duke.edu/v1/models (requires Duke network/VPN). Frozen at v1.0.0 after pilot 8: claude-haiku-5-5 solved 4/5 development challenges vs 1/5 for GPT 4.1 Mini under the same prompt.
model.name: claude-haiku-5-5

pricing.$comment: USD per 1M tokens, used only when the x-litellm-response-cost header is missing. claude-haiku-5-5 rates from GET /v1/model/info on 2026-11-10 (in 0.10 / cached 0.01 / out 0.50).

rate_limit.$comment: Duke gateway per-key limits read from X-Ratelimit-Limit-* headers on 2026-11-09. 429s wait Retry-After (else default_wait_s) up to max_429_retries times; batches wait for the window between attempts.

budget.$comment: Frozen at v1.0.0. Enforced by the controller; model output cannot change them.

path_remap.$comment: NTFS cannot hold '?'; the directory is extracted byte-identically from the pinned commit.
